stage_a_isolation_verified.description: Stage A strictly ignores starting_grid session block, enforces grid_penalty_delta = 0.0, and sets has_penalties_applied: False.

stage_b_penalty_computation_verified.description: Stage B authoritatively applies stewards' starting grid positions, computes grid penalties, and captures pit lane starts.

stage_b_fail_closed_verified.description: Stage B raises OFFICIAL_GRID_UNAVAILABLE when starting_grid block is missing, preventing silent fallback to provisional data.

precedence_contract.rule_2_timestamp_precedence: Later publication timestamp wins within same stage

run_inference_snapshot_audit.identified_limitation: Line 316 strictly enforces: if stage_clean != 'provisional': raise SnapshotValidationError('UNSUPPORTED_STAGE'). As a result, run_inference_snapshot.py can only generate Stage A provisional snapshots and refuses to emit Stage B official_grid snapshots even when an authoritative starting grid block is provided.
run_inference_snapshot_audit.proposed_minimal_fix: Extend argument validation in run_inference_snapshot.py to accept '--stage official_grid', pass stage_clean to LiveFeatureBuilder.build_live_features(stage=stage_clean), and update the snapshot validator to verify hasPenaltiesApplied: True when stage == 'official_grid'.
